items.title: VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
items.content: VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-premises versions contain a critical SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with minimal privileges to escalate to superuser operator access. Any user with Enterprise Read Only role can exploit this flaw to access privileged internal functionality, potentially compromising the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and... items.title: 2026 Year End Phishing Lures
items.content: As organizations approach year-end and fiscal close periods, employees face increased administrative activity in finance, HR, and IT departments. This heightened legitimate communication creates ideal cover for phishing campaigns. Attackers exploit year-end business processes by impersonating compensation adjustments, Q4 financial documents, access reviews, invoice follow-ups, and benefits... This pulse includes 14 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Targeted industries: Finance, Technology, Telecommunications.

items.title: ARTEX in the Wild: Storm-0940 Expands Targeting of IT and Software Vendors
items.content: Throughout October 2026, an actor utilizing ARTEX, an autonomous AI penetration-testing agent, targeted multiple IT and software vendors with attacks focused on identity providers including Okta, Entra, and Cognito. The activity overlaps with Storm-0940, a Chinese-state aligned actor involved in supply-chain attacks. Observed methodologies included mapping applications through JavaScript bundles... Targeted industries: Technology. Associated malware: ARTEX.

items.title: SEO Poisoning Campaign Delivers New Armorsteal Malware
items.content: In September 2026, an SEO poisoning campaign distributed Armorsteal malware through fake websites impersonating Chocolatey package manager and Microsoft Activation Scripts (MAS) tool.
